_comment: How a deluge climbs the tiers, dial by dial (design 5.2).
Its danger is slow to pay off -- a sea two hours from your door is a threat and not yet a hazard -- so
two of its three dials unsettle throughout: `rate` is how fast the sea climbs while it rains and
`downpour` how much of the time it rains, which is the near-constant deluge an unsettled Age can have.
`height` is how far over its written level the sea is carried, and it climbs the tiers step by step: a
